title: Agent used external tools after context compaction without buffering MissingMoebTool signals
description: After conversation compaction, the agent resumed work using external tools (Claude Code's Read, Glob, Edit, Bash) without buffering MissingMoebTool signals as required by the tool-origin policy. In one occurrence, Read/Edit/Bash were used to fix a test race condition post-compaction. In another (run 7588055a), Read and Glob were used in Phase 6 to re-read the signal JSON and spec file for rubric verification context — moeb read_file failed due to path access limits and a wrong file extension (.signal.md vs .signal.json). All operations had moeb equivalents (read_file, search_files, grep_files).
proposed_resolution: After context compaction, re-read the run skill's Tool Origin Policy section to re-establish the signal-buffering obligation before using external tools. Use search_files or grep_files on the index to rediscover file paths rather than constructing them from memory. Emit MissingMoebTool signals when external tools are genuinely required due to path access limitations.
